name: Jalpi Login and Notifications
author: Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
Jalpi Login and Notifications is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that integrates WhatsApp Business messaging into WooCommerce. It enables automated order notifications and secure WhatsApp-based OTP authentication.

This plugin serves two primary functions:

1. Automated WhatsApp Notifications for WooCommerce
Automatically sends WhatsApp messages at key order stages using approved WhatsApp Business templates. Supports dynamic parameters such as order ID, total, items, shipping details, and tracking links.

2. WhatsApp OTP Authentication
Provides secure login and registration using WhatsApp OTPs. Improves user experience and security using rate limiting, attempt tracking, and IP-based lockouts.

Key Capabilities
* Automated WhatsApp notifications for WooCommerce order events
* WhatsApp OTP login and registration
* Template-based messaging with parameter mapping
* Multiple flows per WooCommerce event
* Template browser and template testing
* Logs with masked data
* API connection tester
* Caching system for API results
* Full security features: nonce verification, rate limiting, lockout, sanitized inputs

Company Information

Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd. is the parent organization responsible for developing and maintaining this plugin.

Product Association

Konceptwise manages multiple software products, including Authyo and Jalpi.
This plugin is part of the Jalpi product line and is officially maintained by the Konceptwise development team.

Ownership & Submission Clarification

This plugin is submitted through the official Konceptwise developer account.
All associated domains, including authyo.io and jalpi.com, are owned and operated by Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd.
No external entity or third party is involved in this plugin’s ownership or development.

Key Features

WooCommerce Integration
* Order status notifications for all WooCommerce order events
* Template-based messaging using approved WhatsApp templates
* Multiple flows per event
* Dynamic field mapping
* Header (media/text) support
* Language-based templates
* Idempotency protection to avoid duplicate sends

WhatsApp OTP Authentication
* Login via WhatsApp OTP
* Registration with WhatsApp OTP
* 200+ country support
* Phone number normalization
* WooCommerce phone matching logic
* Rate limiting and lockout rules
* Secure nonce-based AJAX system

Admin Features
* Dashboard with API connection status
* Template browser and tester
* Flow builder for message automations
* Debug logs viewer
* Cache management
* OTP settings panel

Privacy & Data

Data Collected
* Phone numbers (stored in user meta)
* Email addresses (optional)
* Order information (used for template placeholders)
* IP addresses (rate limiting only)

Data Sharing
* Shared only with Jalpi API for WhatsApp message delivery
* No third-party sharing beyond Jalpi
* All communication via HTTPS

Security
* Masked data in logs
* Secure API key storage
* Nonce validation
* Rate limits, attempt tracking, IP lockouts
* File + transient caching

Please review Jalpi Privacy Policy: https://jalpi.com/privacy-policy/

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses Jalpi API (owned by Konceptwise) for WhatsApp messaging.

API Endpoints
* POST /SendTemplateMessage
* GET /GetConnectionStatus
* GET /GetTemplateList
* GET /GetCountryListWithCode

Country List API
URL: https://app.jalpi.com/api/GetCountryListWithCode
Cached for 30 days, no personal data sent.

Security
* HTTPS enforced
* API key authentication required
* Error logging with masked data

Support

For support, please visit https://jalpi.com/contact/
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/jalpi-login-and-notifications/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate plugin.
  3. Open Jalpi Login menu → Settings.
  4. Enter your Jalpi API key and test API connection.
  5. (Optional) Create message flows for WooCommerce.
  6. (Optional) Enable OTP login and registration.

Shortcodes
* [jalpi_ln_login] – WhatsApp OTP login form
* [jalpi_ln_register] – WhatsApp OTP registration form
* Backward compatible: [bwj_login], [bwj_register]
sections.faq:
Do I need a Jalpi account?

Yes, sign up at https://jalpi.com/.

Can I use this without WooCommerce?

Yes, OTP login/register works without WooCommerce.

How many OTP attempts are allowed?

Default is 3 attempts with a 30-minute lockout. Configurable in settings.

How do I add OTP login?

Enable in OTP settings and use shortcode [jalpi_ln_login].

Is customer data secure?

Yes, phone numbers stored in WordPress, masked logs, HTTPS API, nonce validation.
